format: Scandal-to-market-impact: open with a shocking personal headline, connect it to real stock movement and a broader consequence, close with a takeaway lesson and follow CTA.
hookPattern: The [shocking personal story] just cost [person/company] [specific dollar amount].
hook: Jensen Huang's alleged spy scandal just wiped $225 billion from Nvidia's market cap in a single day.
beats: Nvidia dropped 5% while AMD ran 13% on the same day — that spread tells you exactly how the market is pricing this risk right now.
Beyond the stock, Jensen has no prenup, so a divorce could pull another $80 billion from his personal net worth. And the national security angle makes this bigger than any earnings miss.
cta: This is what I'm watching closely — not financial advice, do your own research. Follow for more market breakdowns.
whyOriginalWorked: It hooked with celebrity scandal energy, stacked concrete numbers fast, and made a dry market story feel personal and urgent.
